writeup.title: feat(reviews): add review moderation and flagging system
writeup.summary: Adds customer review flagging and admin moderation capabilities. Reviews automatically become hidden after receiving three flags, and are excluded from public product ratings while hidden. Includes a new migration and API endpoints for flagging reviews and listing hidden ones.
changes: Added status field to reviews and created review_flags table via migration 0004.
Added POST /reviews/<id>/flag endpoint allowing customers to flag reviews with a valid reason.
Added GET /reviews/hidden endpoint for administrators to view hidden reviews.
Updated public product reviews and rating summaries to exclude hidden reviews.
Added unit tests covering the flagging rules, auto-hiding behavior, and admin-only access.

functions.what_it_does: Flags a review by ID with a given reason on behalf of the current user and returns its updated status and flag count.
Lists paginated reviews hidden by flags for administrators only.
Returns a query for published reviews for a product, ordered by creation date newest first.
Calculates the average rating and count of published reviews for a given product.
Records a review flag from a user after validating reasons, ensuring users cannot flag their own or duplicate flags, and hides the review if the flag threshold is reached.
Returns a query for hidden reviews, ordered by ID oldest first.
Placeholder function for scoring review text with a moderation model.

writeup.release_note: Customers can flag reviews (POST /reviews/<id>/flag). Three flags hide a review; admins list hidden reviews at GET /reviews/hidden.
